title: Senate Floor Debate
subtitle: S.2200 — Student Loan Relief and Accountability Act

metadata.laymanSummary: A bill to cap student loan payments at 5% of discretionary income and provide automatic forgiveness after 20 years failed in the Senate, with fiscal cost concerns driving most opposition.

data.billTitle: Student Loan Relief and Accountability Act — Capping repayments at 5% of income and forgiving remaining debt after 20 years

speakers.name: Sen. Bernie Sanders
speakers.title: I-VT · Senate HELP
speakers.quote: 45 million Americans are carrying $1.7 trillion in student debt. Teachers in this country are paying $800 a month on loans taken out to earn the degree that lets them serve our children. We are literally making it financially punishing to pursue public service. This bill says: go be a teacher, a social worker, a nurse — and we've got your back.

speakers.name: Sen. Sheldon Whitehouse
speakers.title: D-RI · Senate Judiciary
speakers.quote: The student debt crisis is an economic crisis. When 35-year-olds cannot buy houses because they are still paying off degrees they earned in 2012, the entire housing market and consumer economy suffers. This is not charity — it is economic stimulus targeted at the demographic most crushed by rising costs.

speakers.name: Sen. Rand Paul
speakers.title: R-KY · Senate
speakers.quote: This bill tells every plumber, every electrician, every contractor who chose a trade over a four-year college: your choice was wise, but you still have to pay for the philosophy degrees of people who made a different choice. I'm against taxing tradespeople to subsidize six-figure degrees with no job market.

data.title: What This Vote Means
data.text: S.2200 failed 46-53. The bill would have codified income-driven repayment at 5% of discretionary income and mandated forgiveness of remaining balances after 20 years (10 for public service workers). The CBO scored the bill at $540 billion over ten years. Seven Democrats in competitive states joined all Republicans in opposition over fiscal concerns.
